row.team_price_text: Starter: $490/year flat ($49/month monthly), unlimited team members
row.evidence: FirstPromoter's SSO guide says SAML SSO is available on the Enterprise plan and that sign-in fails with user_not_found unless the team member was invited first; no SCIM appears on the pricing page, help centre or API docs.
row.notes: Flat account pricing tied to affiliate revenue, not seats (team members unlimited on every plan): Starter $490/yr, Business $990/yr, Enterprise $1,490/yr ($49/$99/$149 monthly). SAML 2.0 SSO (custom app in Okta, Google Workspace, Entra ID, OneLogin) is Enterprise-only and has no JIT: members must be invited. Team members are invited, deactivated and deleted by hand in Settings > Team. The Admin API (Bearer API key + ACCOUNT-ID header) manages promoters (affiliates), referrals and tracking, not dashboard team members.

scim.notes: Not mentioned on the pricing page, in the help-centre sitemap (77 articles) or the developer docs index (llms.txt).

user_api.notes: Admin API covers promoters, referrals, rewards and tracking; no endpoints for dashboard team members are listed in the docs index.

okta.notes: okta.com/integrations/firstpromoter/ returns 404; vendor guide uses a custom SAML 2.0 app.

fallbacks.notes: SSO requires the team member to be invited first (user_not_found otherwise). Team list can be exported as CSV (export, not import).
